NAICS: 333924 - Industrial Truck, Tractor, Trailer, and Stacker Machinery Manufacturing

Product Specifications: See ATTACHMENT 1 - SOURCES SOUGHT MEMO

How to Submit Responses:

1. Submit the required information to the following Contracting Officer (CO) and Contract Specialist (CS): 

Primary Point of Contact (CS): Vida Mata - vida.mata@us.af.mil 

Secondary Point of Contact (CO): Ryan Hopkin - Ryan.hopkin@us.af.mil                                                                                           

2. Please include "SOURCES SOUGHT – Rota Naval Base Forklift Rental" in the e-mail subject line.

3. If you have any questions regarding this source sought, please submit them via e-mail.

4. The sources sought closing date is 15 May 2026, at 08:00 hrs Central European Summer Time (CEST)

5. All responses must be in English.
